"Verse.ThingDef definition, not an instance. Native category, content category tree and query groups are distinct."
type ThingDef {

  defName: String
  "Native ThingDef.label; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  label: String
  "Native ThingDef.thingClass; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  thingClass: String
  "Native ThingDef.category; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  category: String
  "Native ThingDef.stackLimit; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  stackLimit: Int
  "Native ThingDef.alwaysHaulable; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  alwaysHaulable: Boolean
  "Native ThingDef.designateHaulable; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  designateHaulable: Boolean
  "Native ThingDef.EverHaulable; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  EverHaulable: Boolean
  "Native ThingDef.IsMedicine; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  IsMedicine: Boolean
  "Native ThingDef.IsWeapon; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  IsWeapon: Boolean
  "Native ThingDef.IsIngestible; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."

  "Native ThingDef.CountAsResource; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."

    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0): ThingDefThingCategoriesSlice
  comps(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0): ThingDefCompsSlice
  "Native ThingDef.ingestible reference; only selected child members are read."
  ingestible: IngestibleProperties

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."

  total: Int
  offset: Int
  returned: Int
  hasMore: Boolean
  nextOffset: Int

}

  "Native ThingCategoryDef.label; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."

  offset: Int
  returned: Int

  nextOffset: Int

  drugCategory: String

  HumanEdible: Boolean
  "Native IngestibleProperties.IsMeal; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  IsMeal: Boolean
  "Native IngestibleProperties.CachedNutrition; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."

  "Native IngestibleProperties.maxNumToIngestAtOnce; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."

"Unknown component; no custom getters are invoked."
type UnsupportedThingComp implements ThingComp {
  "Transport metadata; not a native gameplay member."
  ref: String
  "Transport metadata; not a native gameplay member."
  runtimeType: String
  "Transport metadata; not a native gameplay member."
  supportedType: String
  "Transport metadata; not a native gameplay member."
  supported: Boolean
}

type Query {
  game: Game
  maps(
    "Exact IDs; at most 50. Empty list matches nothing."
    ids: [ID!]): [Map]
  pawn(
    "Exact pawn ID."
    id: ID!): Pawn
  colonists(
    "Exact IDs; at most 50. Empty list matches nothing."
    ids: [ID!],
    "Restrict to one loaded map."
    mapId: ID,
    "Case-insensitive display-name substring, at most 128 characters."
    name: String,
    "Page size 1..50, default 20."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Cursor from the previous complete page, same load and filters."
    after: String): ColonistPage
  colony: Colony
  thing(
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    id: String!,
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    mapId: String): Thing
  things(
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    mapId: String!,
    "Native query group: HaulableEver, HaulableAlways, HaulableEverOrMinifiable or Everything. This is not pawn-specific usability."
    requestGroup: String = "HaulableEver",
    "Exact IDs; at most 50. Empty list matches nothing."
    defNames: [ID!],
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    name: String,
    "Default true: exclude fogged map things."
    visibleOnly: Boolean = true,
    "Returned page size 1..50. Identity scanning is separately bounded by the game-thread deadline."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    after: String): ThingPage
  thing_def(
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    defName: String!): ThingDef
  thing_defs(
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    name: String,
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    categoryDefName: String,
    "Returned page size 1..50. Identity scanning is separately bounded by the game-thread deadline."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    after: String): ThingDefPage
  map(
    "Exact identifier, or case-insensitive substring for name. after is a load/filter-bound cursor."
    id: String!): NativeMap
}

"Active game's directly observed state."
type Game {
  "Whether the game is paused."
  paused: Boolean
  "Current viewed map; null if none."
  currentMapId: ID
}

"An active, loaded map."
type Map {
  "Stable map ID within the save."
  id: ID!
  "Display name; not a unique identifier."
  name: String
  "Whether this is the currently viewed map."
  isCurrent: Boolean
  "Game's player-home map flag."
  isPlayerHome: Boolean
  "Number of spawned free colonists; excludes caravans/prisoners."
  colonistCount: Int
  "Game-provided active visible hostile threat signal, not an overall safety assessment."
  hasVisibleThreat: Boolean
}

"Currently addressable spawned free colonist on a loaded map. Stable identity joins selected nested sections."
type Pawn {
  id: ID!
  name: String
  mapId: String
  status: Status
  mood: Mood
  health: Health
  equipment: Pawn_EquipmentTracker
  apparel: Pawn_ApparelTracker
  inventory: Pawn_InventoryTracker
  carryTracker: Pawn_CarryTracker
  profile: Profile
  statDefinitions(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0,
    "Case-insensitive substring of definition name or label. Does not compute stat values."
    search: String): PawnStatDefinitionsSlice
  stats(
    "Slice size 1..16."
    first: Int = 16,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0,
    "Explicit StatDef names, 1..16. No automatic relevance selection."
    defNames: [String!]!): PawnStatsSlice
}

"Current flags, job targets, position and needs. This is observation, not a risk score."
type Status {
  downed: Boolean
  drafted: Boolean
  dead: Boolean
  inMentalState: Boolean
  mentalState: String
  position: Position
  currentJob: Job
  needs(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0): StatusNeedsSlice
}

type Position {
  x: Int
  y: Int
  z: Int
  mapId: String
}

type Job {
  id: String
  defName: String
  report: String
  targets(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0): JobTargetsSlice
}

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."
type JobTargetsSlice {
  items: [JobTarget]
  total: Int
  offset: Int
  returned: Int
  hasMore: Boolean
  nextOffset: Int
  complete: Boolean
}

"A target can be a Thing or a cell; fields not applicable to that kind are null."
type JobTarget {
  slot: String
  kind: String
  thingId: String
  mapId: String
  x: Int
  y: Int
  z: Int
}

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."
type StatusNeedsSlice {
  items: [Need]
  total: Int
  offset: Int
  returned: Int
  hasMore: Boolean
  nextOffset: Int
  complete: Boolean
}

"Actual need record: level is raw, maxLevel is its maximum, percentage is 0..1. Food is not stock."
type Need {
  defName: String
  label: String
  level: Float
  maxLevel: Float
  percentage: Float
}

"Mood tracker; null if this pawn does not have one."
type Mood {
  "Current mood need fraction, not the instantaneous target."
  level: Float
  "Game CurInstantLevelPercentage: current instantaneous/target mood from thoughts, not a historical observation."
  instant: Float
  breakThresholds: Thresholds
  thoughtGroups(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0,
    "Default true: UI-visible facts. Set false explicitly to inspect internal records."
    visibleOnly: Boolean = true): MoodThoughtGroupsSlice
  memories(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0,
    "Default true: UI-visible facts. Set false explicitly to inspect internal records."
    visibleOnly: Boolean = true): MoodMemoriesSlice
}

"Game-calculated mental break thresholds, not plugin risk classifications."
type Thresholds {
  minor: Float
  major: Float
  extreme: Float
}

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."
type MoodThoughtGroupsSlice {
  items: [ThoughtGroup]
  total: Int
  offset: Int
  returned: Int
  hasMore: Boolean
  nextOffset: Int
  complete: Boolean
}

"Current effective mood grouping, with the game-calculated group contribution; not the sum of every memory."
type ThoughtGroup {
  defName: String
  label: String
  stageIndex: Int
  "Effective mood offset for this group as computed by the game. Do not sum raw memory offsets as a substitute."
  moodOffset: Float
  memberCount: Int
  members(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0): ThoughtGroupMembersSlice
}

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."
type ThoughtGroupMembersSlice {
  items: [Thought]
  total: Int
  offset: Int
  returned: Int
  hasMore: Boolean
  nextOffset: Int
  complete: Boolean
}

"Thought instance. ref is valid within this observation only, not across queries or saves."
type Thought {
  ref: String
  referenceScope: String
  defName: String
  label: String
  description: String
  stageIndex: Int
  "Individual thought offset; grouping/stacking can change its effective contribution."
  moodOffset: Float
  kind: String
  otherPawnId: String
  "Memory age in game ticks; null for non-memory thoughts."
  ageTicks: Int
  "Game memory duration in ticks; null for non-memory thoughts."
  durationTicks: Int
}

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."
type MoodMemoriesSlice {
  items: [Thought]
  total: Int
  offset: Int
  returned: Int
  hasMore: Boolean
  nextOffset: Int
  complete: Boolean
}

"Hediffs include injuries, diseases, implants and other health conditions."
type Health {
  summary: HealthSummary
  capacities(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0): HealthCapacitiesSlice
  conditions(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0,
    "Default true: UI-visible facts. Set false explicitly to inspect internal records."
    visibleOnly: Boolean = true): HealthConditionsSlice
  bodyParts(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0): HealthBodyPartsSlice
}

type HealthSummary {
  healthPercent: Float
  "Game PainTotal value, distinct from injury severity and health percentage."
  pain: Float
  "Raw game BleedRateTotal, not a health percentage or a computed survival-time estimate."
  bleedRate: Float
  downed: Boolean
  inPainShock: Boolean
}

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."
type HealthCapacitiesSlice {
  items: [Capacity]
  total: Int
  offset: Int
  returned: Int
  hasMore: Boolean
  nextOffset: Int
  complete: Boolean
}

type Capacity {
  defName: String
  label: String
  level: Float
}

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."
type HealthConditionsSlice {
  items: [Condition]
  total: Int
  offset: Int
  returned: Int
  hasMore: Boolean
  nextOffset: Int
  complete: Boolean
}

type Condition {
  id: String
  defName: String
  label: String
  description: String
  "Raw Hediff severity; meaning/range depends on its definition. Not a universal 0..1 health fraction."
  severity: Float
  severityLabel: String
  visible: Boolean
  part: BodyPart
  tending: Tending
  immunity: Immunity
}

"Part key is scoped to the owner pawn and body definition/index; label/defName alone is not a unique part."
type BodyPart {
  key: String
  defName: String
  label: String
  index: Int
  parentKey: String
  health: Float
  maxHealth: Float
}

"Only present for conditions with a tending component."
type Tending {
  isTended: Boolean
  quality: Float
  "Remaining tending duration in game ticks; null when not tended."
  ticksLeft: Int
}

"Only present for conditions with an immunity component."
type Immunity {
  level: Float
  fullyImmune: Boolean
}

"A bounded slice of this query's list. Offset continuation is a fresh observation, not a frozen snapshot. Null means unavailable/not applicable, empty items with total=0 means observed empty."
type HealthBodyPartsSlice {
  items: [BodyPart]
  total: Int
  offset: Int
  returned: Int
  hasMore: Boolean
  nextOffset: Int
  complete: Boolean
}

"Verse.Pawn_EquipmentTracker; equipped things, not inventory or hauling."
type Pawn_EquipmentTracker {
  "Native Pawn_EquipmentTracker.Primary reference; only selected child members are read."
  Primary: ThingReference
  AllEquipmentListForReading(
    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."

"Detached Thing identity. Resolve id through thing; no recursive object expansion."

  "Native Thing.stackCount; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  stackCount: Int

  HitPoints: Int
  "Native Thing.MaxHitPoints; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  MaxHitPoints: Int
  "Native Thing.Spawned; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  Spawned: Boolean
  "Native Thing.Destroyed; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  Destroyed: Boolean
  "Native Thing.IngestibleNow; selected getter only. Null without issue means not applicable; issue means failed/unavailable."
  IngestibleNow: Boolean
  "Native Thing.def reference; only selected child members are read."
  def: ThingDef
  "Native Thing.Stuff reference; only selected child members are read."
  Stuff: ThingDef
  "Native Thing.Map reference; only selected child members are read."
  Map: NativeMap
  "Native Thing.MapHeld reference; only selected child members are read."
  MapHeld: NativeMap
  "Native Thing.Position reference; only selected child members are read."

  "Native Thing.PositionHeld reference; only selected child members are read."

  "IThingHolder.GetDirectlyHeldThings for supported holders. Unsupported holders produce an issue, not an empty container."

  stats(
    "Slice size 1..16."

    "Explicit StatDef names; no automatic relevance selection."

    "Slice size 1..100."
    first: Int = 20,
    "Start index in this observation; 0..8192."
    offset: Int = 0): ThingAllCompsSlice

query_rules: Read-only query; one operation. Aliases, variables and bounded inline type fragments supported; named fragments/directives/introspection/mutation unavailable. Native things/thing_defs/map targets expose selected original members, holders and storage groups. Thing group HaulableEver is not current hauling eligibility. Unknown component classes return metadata, not reflected fields. Exact native type/member descriptions are available using describe_game_schema. Target pawn by stable ID, then combine status/mood/health/equipment/profile. colonists locates spawned free colonists (not caravans/prisoners); first 1..50 default20. Nested slices use first 1..100 default20, offset 0..8192; offset continuation samples current data, not frozen history. Slice complete=false means selected fields failed; nextOffset is then null. Thought ref is observation-local. UI-visible thoughts/conditions are default; visibleOnly=false must be explicit. Discover StatDef names via pawn.statDefinitions(search), then request stats(defNames). Null without an issue can mean not applicable; observed empty lists have total=0. Limits: depth12, fields512, combined nested cost20000.
